values.note: Town of Lansing residents: $30 a night without electric (sites 22-27), $46 with electric (sites 1-20); non-residents $32 / $50 (so +$2 or +$4 a night). Residents use promo code LANSINGRES on Campspot. Weekly and monthly rates by phone. Campspot adds a non-refundable 4% booking fee. Extra children $2 a night each; out-of-town visitors pay the park entrance fee per car.

fees.source: https://www.lansingrec.com/parksrec/page/campingpavilion-reservations ('The nightly fee is $46 for Lansing Residents and $50 a night for Non-Residents'; no-electric sites 'The nightly fee is $30 for Lansing Residents and $32 a night for Non-Residents'; 'use promo code LANSINGRES') + Campspot park terms for Myers Park ('additional, non-refundable 4% booking fee'; 'EXTRA children ... $2/night'; 'Call for monthly/weekly pricing'), read 2026-10-21 (Town of Lansing 2026 pages)

values.note: Campspot (paid in full at booking) or the Parks and Recreation office, 607-533-7388. Holiday weekends need 3 nights and are non-refundable. Check-in noon, check-out 11 am; at most 2 adults and 4 children per site.

booking.source: https://www.lansingrec.com/parksrec/page/campingpavilion-reservations ('Reserve a Campsite Online'; 'Holiday weekends are a 3-night minimum and are Non-refundable. All reservations MUST be paid in full at the time of reservation') + Campspot park terms ('Campers may make reservations with the Parks and Recreation office'; 'Check in time is 12PM'; 'Campsite occupancy is limited to 2 adults and 4 children'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Sites 1-20 have 30 and 50 A electric and water; sites 22-27 have water but no electric (generators allowed).

hookups.source: https://www.lansingrec.com/parksrec/page/campingpavilion-reservations ('Electric Hook-up (30 & 50 amps)', 'Water hookup'; sites 22-27 'Water hook ups and WiFi are also available. Generators are allowed'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 19 electric sites (numbered 1-20) and 6 no-electric RV sites (22-27, added 2026, 35-ft RV max). No length is posted for the electric sites.

sites.source: https://www.lansingrec.com/parksrec/page/campingpavilion-reservations ('Camping: with electric (Sites 1-20) ... 19 Campsites'; 'Sites 22-27 ... 35ft RV max ... 6 campsites'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.lansingrec.com/parksrec/page/campingpavilion-reservations ('WiFi', 'Dump station is available') + Campspot park terms (Amenities: 'Hot showers', 'Dump station'), read 2026-10-21

note: Town of Lansing park on Cayuga Lake; marina, boat launches and beach; some sites have water views. --Claude
summary: Confirmed town-run (Campspot legal name 'Myers Park, a New York Governmental Entity'), phone 607-533-7388, Campspot booking, electric + water, dump. Changed fees from the non-resident figures (32-50) to the resident base $30-46 with a +$2/night non-resident surcharge ($4 at electric sites, in fees.note). Changed electric 30 -> 50 A (30 & 50 A posted). Added 25 sites (19 electric + 6 no-electric, those 35 ft max), holiday 3-night minimum, Campspot URL, showers, WiFi. Note trimmed of counts/hookups/dump/booking. Not stated: season dates (Campspot showed no 2027 availability yet), max length of the electric sites.
